children: Bank of America on Tuesday raised its Brent price forecast to $83 per barrel for the second half of the year, citing ongoing disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz.
It also raised its Brent forecast to $75 per barrel for 2027.

The bank sees Brent oil trading in a $95 to $120 per barrel range if skirmishes curbing oil flows continue into year end, and sees prices reaching $150 per barrel in the case of a broader conflict resulting in major energy infrastructure damage
